# AI Career Copilot

> Autonomous AI-powered career platform that discovers scholarships, jobs, and work permits worldwide, then applies to them automatically.

## Product

AI Career Copilot is a SaaS platform that uses browser automation (Playwright) and large language models (Claude/GPT) to automate the entire job/scholarship/visa application process.

## Features

- **Smart Discovery Engine**: Scrapes DAAD, Chevening, Fulbright, LinkedIn, Indeed, and government portals for opportunities
- **Auto-Apply Agents**: Three specialized AI agents (Scholarship Scout, Job Hunter, Permit Pathfinder) that navigate portals, fill forms, and submit applications
- **LLM-Powered Form Filling**: Uses Claude/GPT to generate personalized cover letters, essays, and form responses
- **Resume Tailoring**: AI rewrites resumes to match each specific job description
- **Visa Intelligence**: Probability scoring for work permits across 6 countries (Germany, Netherlands, UK, Switzerland, Canada, Australia)
- **Interview Preparation**: Company research, question generation, salary intelligence, and briefing documents
- **SEO Optimizer**: Optimizes resumes and LinkedIn profiles for ATS systems and recruiter search
- **Real-Time Monitoring**: Live terminal logs via SSE, application status tracking, and health dashboard
- **Multi-Channel Notifications**: Email, Slack, Telegram, Discord webhook integrations
- **Audit Trail**: Compliance-grade logging of all agent actions

## Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, Tailwind CSS, Recharts
- **Backend**: Next.js API Routes, MongoDB (with in-memory fallback)
- **Automation**: Playwright with anti-detection, browser pool management
- **AI**: Anthropic Claude API for content generation
- **Scheduling**: node-cron for automated campaign execution

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/auto-apply` — Launch auto-apply workflow
- `GET/POST /api/applications` — Application CRUD
- `GET /api/analytics` — Dashboard statistics
- `GET /api/health` — System health check
- `POST /api/interview` — Generate interview prep package
- `POST /api/seo/optimize` — Optimize resume/LinkedIn for SEO
- `POST /api/seo/analyze` — Analyze content SEO score
- `GET /api/stream` — SSE real-time log streaming
- `GET /api/discoveries` — Discovery engine results
- `GET/POST /api/campaigns` — Campaign management
